correctness.rationale: PASS: Ky Fan/von Neumann diagonal submajorization bounds k-th largest |A_ii| by H_min(k,r)(q)/k when max_j j^q s_j(A)=1. The normalized output is consequently bounded by max_{1<=k<=n} k^(q-1) H_min(k,r)(q). For k<=r, positive Laplace integral f_k=(1/Gamma(q)) int_0^infty t^(q-1)(1-e^-t)/[k(e^(t/k)-1)]dt strictly increases with k because (e^x-1)/x increases; for k>=r, k^(q-1) H_r monotone by sign(q-1). This yields n^(q-1)H_r for q>1, H_r at q=1, r^(q-1)H_r for q<1. Fourier-unitary conjugation of diag(1,2^-q,...,r^-q) produces sharp flat diagonals on support m. Equality in all Ky Fan and trace-norm duality inequalities forces prescribed singular values, flat nonzero diagonal modulus on support m, and a diagonal-unitary multiple of a positive semidefinite matrix. I independently checked the optimizing finite scalar sequences for q=1/2,1,2,7/3 and n/r=3/1,5/3,7/7. The 22604-case checker source was inspected, not used as proof. Boundary p=1 and r=n correctly included; no p=infinity claim.
